cmd: cd /app/vendor && tar xzf sqlite-fossil-release.tar.gz && ls -la /app/vendor/ && ls /app/vendor/sqlite-fossil-release | head
which gcc make && gcc --version | head -1 && cat /app/vendor/sqlite/VERSION
command -v gcc cc make gmake autoconf 2>&1; echo "---"; ls /usr/bin | grep -E '^(gcc|cc|make|clang)' ; echo "---"; cat /etc/os-release | head -3
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -3 && apt-get install -y -qq gcc make 2>&1 | tail -5
mkdir -p /app/sqlite && cp -r /app/vendor/sqlite/* /app/sqlite/ && cd /app/sqlite && ls | head -5 && cat VERSION

cp /app/sqlite/Makefile.linux-generic /app/sqlite/Makefile && cd /app/sqlite && sed -i 's/^CFLAGS =$/CFLAGS = -g -O0 -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage/' Makefile && grep -n "^CFLAGS\|^SHELL_OPT\|^LDFLAGS" Makefile | head -10
cd /app/sqlite && nm sqlite3 | grep -c "gcov" ; echo "---"; ls *.gcno 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /app/sqlite && sqlite3 :memory: "CREATE TABLE t(a,b); INSERT INTO t VALUES(1,'hello'),(2,'world'); SELECT * FROM t WHERE a=2;" && echo "=== gcda files ===" && ls *.gcda 2>/dev/null && echo "=== gcov check ===" && which gcov && gcov --version | head -1

echo "=== 1. PATH resolution ===" && which sqlite3 && echo "=== 2.
